credits.title: Nayyi Navelli
credits.overview: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

credits.title: Jumper
credits.overview: A cable operator with an unusual talent for 'invisibility' is forced into an investigation when an MLA goes missing. What he uncovers is bigger than kidnapping.

credits.title: Maa Behen
credits.overview: When trouble knocks on her door, a mother and her estranged daughters attempt to cover up a crime in a nosy colony where no secret is safe.

credits.title: Stree 2
credits.overview: Following the events of 'Stree', the town of Chanderi is being haunted again. This time, women are mysteriously abducted by a terrifying headless entity. Once again, it's up to Vicky and friends to save their town and loved ones.

credits.title: Vinci Da
credits.overview: A gifted make-up artist gets entangled up in a world of crime with a psychopathic vigilante.
